"""Migrated Meridian CRM 4.2 opportunity_pipeline workflow."""

from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any, Callable


Guard = Callable[[dict], bool]
Action = tuple[str, str, str | None]
Transition = tuple[str, str, str, Guard | None, tuple[Action, ...]]


def _positive_amount(record: dict) -> bool:
    value: Any = record.get("AMT", "")
    if value is None or value == "":
        value = 0
    return Decimal(str(value)) > Decimal("0")


def _close_date_set(record: dict) -> bool:
    return record.get("CLOSE_DT", "") != "00000000"


def _lost_reason_set(record: dict) -> bool:
    value = record.get("LOST_RSN", "")
    return isinstance(value, str) and value != ""


_TRANSITIONS: tuple[Transition, ...] = (
    (
        "P",
        "Q",
        "qualify",
        _positive_amount,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "25"),
            ("audit", "OPP_QUAL", None),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "Q",
        "N",
        "advance",
        None,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "60"),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "N",
        "W",
        "close_won",
        _close_date_set,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "100"),
            ("audit", "OPP_WON", None),
            ("notify", "won_deal", None),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "P",
        "L",
        "close_lost",
        _lost_reason_set,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "0"),
            ("audit", "OPP_LOST", None),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "Q",
        "L",
        "close_lost",
        _lost_reason_set,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "0"),
            ("audit", "OPP_LOST", None),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "N",
        "L",
        "close_lost",
        _lost_reason_set,
        (
            ("set", "STAGE_PCT", "0"),
            ("audit", "OPP_LOST", None),
        ),
    ),
)


def fire(state: str, event: str, record: dict) -> dict:
    """Fire the first matching transition in legacy XML document order."""
    for source, target, transition_event, guard, actions in _TRANSITIONS:
        if state != source or event != transition_event:
            continue
        if guard is not None and not guard(record):
            continue

        updated_record = dict(record)
        audits: list[str] = []
        notifies: list[str] = []

        for action_type, name, value in actions:
            if action_type == "set":
                updated_record[name] = value
            elif action_type == "audit":
                audits.append(name)
            elif action_type == "notify":
                notifies.append(name)

        return {
            "state": target,
            "record": updated_record,
            "audits": audits,
            "notifies": notifies,
            "matched": True,
        }

    return {
        "state": state,
        "record": dict(record),
        "audits": ["WF_NOMATCH"],
        "notifies": [],
        "matched": False,
    }
